geofence.simulatorDesc: Test how the application behaves inside or outside the 50-meter geo-fence.
geofence.grantedDesc: You are at the barbershop. You can now join the queue.
geofence.lockedDesc: You must be inside the barbershop (within 50 meters) to join.
geofence.modalDesc: To prevent remote queue-stuffing and ensure fairness for clients waiting physically at the shop, BarberFlow requires access to your physical location.
geofence.modalStep1: Click the lock or settings icon in your browser address bar.
geofence.modalStep3: Click "Try Again" below to refresh your status.
